page.overview:
What is Virbank City?

Virbank City is a city/location located in southwestern Unova. It is the home to Pokéstar Studios where people from all over Unova make their own movies and battle real Trainers for the movies. The city also has its own Pokémon Gym, specializing in -type moves.

To the east of the city, there is a ship that can take Trainers to Castelia City. And to the south, lies the Virbank Complex.
